rules.description: Access to a common credential or secret path

Network send attempt during offline lifecycle execution

Network bind or listen setup during offline lifecycle execution
Inbound connection acceptance attempt
Network socket creation
Shell, downloader, or remote access process
Executable process
Child process creation
Anonymous memory file creation or descriptor-backed execution
Process tracing or inspection attempt
Filesystem mutation outside disposable writable roots
Filesystem mutation inside a disposable writable root
Deletion or permission change
Truncation or descriptor-backed file mutation
File read or metadata inspection
Directory enumeration
Access to a path commonly used to detect containers or tracing
Clock inspection or requested delay
Observed behavior without a more specific rule
